αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (ἑὸν αὐτοῦ ’his own very own’): ’of himself’ · also the fixed adv. αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot, right here’
αὐτός: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. sg.: ’he himself’
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτῷ: αὐτός — self; masc. dat. sg.: ’himself’, reinforcing a personal pronoun (σοὶ δ’ αὐτῷ ’to you yourself’)
αὖ: αὖ — again, in turn, back; adv., shorter form of αὖτε
αὖτε: αὖτε — again, in turn, on the other hand; adv.
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γέρον: γέρων — old man; masc. voc. sg.
γέρων: γέρων — old man; masc. nom. sg.
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle

γλαυκῶπις: γλαυκῶπις — epithet of Athena: ’gleaming-eyed’ (or ’owl-eyed’; sense uncertain); fem. nom. sg.
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δασσάμενοι: δατέομαι — divide, share out; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl., epic doubled σ (= Attic δασάμενοι)
δηθὰ: δηθά — for a long time, long; adv.
δώμαθ: δῶμα — house, home; neut. acc. pl., elided (δώμαθ’ = δώματα before a rough breathing)
δώματ: δῶμα — house, home; neut. acc. pl., elided (δώματ’ = δώματα)
δώματα: δῶμα — house, dwelling; neut. acc. pl. (plural for a single dwelling): ’house, home’
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δὸς: δίδωμι — give, grant; aor. imper. 2 sg.
δῖαν: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; fem. acc. sg. δῖαν, here extended to the sea (ἅλα δῖαν ’the heavenly brine’) rather than a hero
δῶμα: δῶμα — house, hall, dwelling; acc. sg.
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also introducing an indirect question after a verb of asking or telling: ’whether’ (εἰ δή ’whether indeed’) · also in εἰ δ’ ἄγε, an interjectional idiom with the imperative: ’come now, well then’
εἰδομένη: εἴδομαι — seem, make oneself like, appear as (+ dat.); pres. part. fem. nom. sg. · also functioning as aor. part. (the same -όμενος form serves both in Homer), ’having made herself like’ (Μέντορι εἰδομένη)
εἴπω: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. subj. 1 sg.
εὐχόμενος: εὔχομαι — pray, vow, boast; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’praying’
εὔχετ: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; impf. 3 sg., elided (εὔχετ’ = εὔχετο), + dat.: ’prayed to’
εὔχομαι: εὔχομαι — declare oneself, avow, boast, pray; pres. 1 sg.: ’I declare myself (to be)’
ζεὺς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before rough breathing, cf. ἔφαθ’) — and; connective particle
θείειν: θέω — run; pres. inf., epic θείειν (= Attic θεῖν): ’to run’ (πέρι θείειν ταχύς ’exceedingly swift to run’)
θείοιο: θεῖος — divine, godlike; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
θοὴν: θοός — swift, quick; fem. acc. sg.
θρόνους: θρόνος — chair, seat of honour; acc. pl.
θυμός: θυμός — heart, spirit; masc. nom. sg.
θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν)
καθαπτόμενος: καθάπτομαι — accost, address directly, fasten on with words; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
κακκείοντες: κατάκειμαι — lie down; fut. part. masc. nom. pl., reduplicated κ- (= κατακείοντες): ’intending to lie down’

κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν)
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν)
κεῖνος: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. nom. sg.
κλέος: κλέος — fame, renown, report; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. (same form), direct object: μέγα κλέος ἤρατο ’won great fame’; κλέος φέρειν ’bring report’
κλισμούς: κλισμός — chair, seat (lighter than the θρόνος); acc. pl.
κούρῃ: κούρη — girl, maiden, daughter (Attic κόρη); dat. sg.
κοῦροι: κοῦρος — young man, boy; nom. pl.
κρητῆρας: κρητήρ — mixing-bowl (for wine and water); acc. pl.
κτήματά: κτῆμα — possession, piece of property; neut. acc. pl.
κτήματα: κτῆμα — possession, property; neut. nom./acc. pl.
λίσσεσθαι: λίσσομαι — beseech, entreat; pres. inf. used imperativally: ’beseech (him)!’
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg.
μέλαιναν: μέλας — black, dark; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with κῆρα · also agreeing with νῆα (θοὴν ἀνὰ νῆα μέλαιναν ’the swift black ship’)
μή: μή — not; negative particle (used with imperatives and subjunctives, unlike οὐ)
μεγάροισι: μέγαρον — hall; dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
μεγάροισιν: μέγαρον — hall, great room, house; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν), plural for a single house
μεγαθύμου: μεγάθυμος — great-hearted, high-spirited; masc. gen. sg.
μελαίνῃ: μέλας — black; standing epithet of ships; fem. dat. sg. μέλαινα
μενέλαον: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, king of Sparta, brother of Agamemnon; acc. sg.
μενέλαος: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, king of Sparta, brother of Agamemnon; masc. nom. sg.
μετέειπε: μετεῖπον — speak among, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (= Attic μετεῖπε)
μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · with acc. also ’in quest of, in search of’ (μετὰ χαλκόν ’after bronze’)
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’
μοῖραν: μοῖρα — due share, what is fitting, portion, fate; fem. acc. sg. (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’)
μυχῷ: μυχός — innermost part, corner, recess; masc. dat. sg.
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ
μὴ: μή — not; negative particle in wishes, prohibitions, and purpose/fear clauses
νέεσθαι: νέομαι — go, return home; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic νεῖσθαι)
νέον: νέος — new, young; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’newly, for the first time’ · also masc. acc. sg., ’young’ (νέον ἄνδρα ’a young man’)
νέστωρ: Νέστωρ — Nestor, king of Pylos; masc. nom. sg.
νημερτὲς: νημερτής — unerring, infallible; neut. acc. sg. used as a noun, direct object: ’the unerring truth’
νηὸς: ναῦς — ship; gen. sg., epic νηός (= Attic νεώς)
νῆα: ναῦς — ship; acc. sg., epic νῆα
ξανθὸς: ξανθός — fair-haired, yellow, tawny; masc. nom. sg., standing epithet of Menelaus
ξείνους: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); masc. acc. pl.
οἰωνοὶ: οἰωνός — bird of prey, bird of omen; masc. nom. pl.
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’)
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl.
οἶκόνδε: οἶκος — house, home; acc. sg. + suffix -δε ’towards’: ’homeward’
οἶος: οἶος — alone, only; masc. nom. sg.
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὔτ: οὔτε (elided οὔτ’) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὔτε: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὕτω: οὕτω(ς) — thus, so, in this way; adv.
οὕτως: οὕτω(ς) — so, thus, in this way; adv.
οὗτος: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. nom. sg.
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. nom./acc. pl.
πάντας: πᾶς — all, every; masc. acc. pl.
πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πέλαγος: πέλαγος — the open sea, high sea; neut. acc. sg.
παλλὰς: Παλλάς — Pallas, title of Athena of unknown origin (perhaps πάλλω ’brandish’); nom. sg.
παρ: παρά (elided παρ’) — beside, among; + dat. · also + gen., ’from, from the side of’ (παρ’ Ἴλου ’from Ilus’) · also + acc., of motion, ’past, along, beside’ (παρ’ Μίμαντα ’past Mimas’)
παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · also used as an adverb with no case expressed: ’beside, alongside’ (παρὰ … ἐτάνυσσε τράπεζαν ’drew a table up beside (them)’)
πατέρ: πατήρ — father; masc. acc. sg., elided (πατέρ’ = πατέρα)
παῖδες: παῖς — child, son; masc. nom. pl.
πεπνυμένος: πέπνυμαι — have one’s wits about one, be prudent; perf. part. masc. nom. sg. (trad. linked to πνέω ’breathe’, though uncertain), stock epithet: ’prudent’
περ: περ — even, though; concessive particle, esp. with a participle (= Attic καίπερ) · also used to intensify an adverb or pronoun rather than concede a point: ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.: ’many things, greatly’
πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’by far’
ποσειδάωνι: Ποσειδῶν — Poseidon; dat. sg., epic uncontracted
ποτοῖο: πότος — drink, drinking; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου): ’with drink’
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
πρὸς: πρός — towards, against, to; prep. + acc.
πρῶτον: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’first’
πω: πω — yet, up to now; enclitic adv., usu. with a negative
πόλλ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl., elided (πόλλ’ = πολλά): ’many’ · also used adverbially: ‘much, often’ (πόλλ’ ἐπέεσσιν ‘again and again with words’)
πὰρ: παρά (apocope πάρ, functioning as an adverb) — beside, alongside; adv.
πᾶσιν: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl. (ν-movable)
σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
σοῖσι: σός — your, yours; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat.

τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, also marks a standing fact (epic τε)

ταμίη: ταμίη — housekeeper, stewardess, woman with charge of the stores (Attic ταμία, Ionic η for α); nom. sg.
ταῦτά: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’, accented before an enclitic
ταῦτα: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’

τευ: τις, τι — someone, something; indefinite pron., masc./fem. gen. sg., epic τευ (= Attic τινός)
τεὸν: τεός (epic possessive = σός) — your, yours; masc./neut. acc. sg.
τηλέμαχον: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. acc. sg.
τηλέμαχος: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; nom. sg.

τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg.

τοῖς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
τοῖσιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’from/to them’
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. gen. sg. ’of him, that one’
τοῦτον: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. acc. sg.
τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’
τῆλ: τῆλε (elided/apocopated τῆλ’) — far, far away; adv.
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these things, of them’

υἱάσι: υἱός — son; masc. dat. pl., epic stem υἱ- (= Attic υἱοῖς/υἱέσι)
υἷες: υἱός — son; masc. nom. pl., epic υἷες (= Attic υἱεῖς)
φίλε: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. voc. sg.
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own (with kin/body parts serves as a possessive); neut. nom./acc. sg.
φίλος: φίλος — dear, dear one; masc. nom. sg. used as voc.: ’friend’ · also plain attributive adjective, not vocative: ’dear’ (φίλος υἱός ’dear son’)
φωνήσασ: φωνέω — utter, speak aloud, raise one’s voice; aor. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (φωνήσασ’ = φωνήσασα)
ψεῦδος: ψεῦδος — falsehood, lie; neut. acc. sg.
ἀθάνατοι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. nom. pl.: ’the immortals’
ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
ἀθανάτοισιν: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic (= Attic -οις)
ἀθηναίη: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. nom. sg., epic full form (= Ἀθήνη)
ἀνθρώπων: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; gen. pl.
ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; prep. + acc.
ἀπέβη: ἀποβαίνω — go away, depart; aor. 3 sg., augment inside the compound (ἀπ-έ-βη)
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)

ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)

ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg.
ἄελλαι: ἄελλα — storm, squall, gust; fem. nom. pl.
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl.
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.
ἄνακτος: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. gen. sg.
ἄνωγα: ἄνωγα — bid, command, order; perf. 1 sg. with pres. sense: ’I bid’
ἄπο: ἀπό — away from, from; + gen.; accented ἄπο when it follows its noun (anastrophe: φίλων ἄπο) · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὀλέσαντ’ ἄπο = ἀπολέσαντα ’having lost’)

ἄριστοι: ἄριστος — best; superl., masc. nom. pl.
ἅμ: ἅμα (elided ἅμ’) — together with, at the same time as; adv./prep. + dat.
ἐγώ: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. (accented ἐγώ before the enclitic τοι that follows)
ἐθέλεις: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, intend; pres. 2 sg.
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐλθέμεν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. inf., epic ἐλθέμεν (= Attic ἐλθεῖν): ’to come’
ἐμοί: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg., accented (non-enclitic emphatic): ’to me’
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνιαυτῷ: ἐνιαυτός — year; masc. dat. sg., dat. of time when
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat.
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐπ’ … χεῦε = ἐπέχευε ‘poured upon’)

ἐπεστέψαντο: ἐπιστέφω — crown, fill to the brim (from στέφω); aor. 3 pl. mid.

ἐσθλὸν: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; neut./masc. acc. sg.
ἐστίν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., ν-movable form
ἑξείης: ἑξείης — in order, one after another; adv. (Attic ἑξῆς)
ἑτάροισιν: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
ἑτάρους: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); acc. pl.
ἑὰ: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, by-form of ὅς); neut. acc. pl.
ἔβαν: βαίνω — go, walk; aor. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἔβησαν)

ἔκλυον: κλύω — hear, hear of; aor. 1 sg.
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also used relatively, continuing a clause: ’where’ (ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’)
ἔολπα: ἔλπω — cause to hope; perf. ἔολπα, reduplicated, pres. force, 1 sg.: ’I expect, hope’
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔτ: ἔτι — still, yet; adv., elided (ἔτ’ = ἔτι)
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔχευαν: χέω — pour; aor. 3 pl., epic -αν (= Attic ἔχεαν)
ἕζοντο: ἕζομαι — seat oneself, sit down; impf. 3 pl. mid.
ἕκαστος: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. sg.
ἕλε: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἷλε)
ἠῶθεν: ἠώς — dawn; adv. ἠῶθεν, -θεν suffix ’from’: ’at dawn’
ἡδυπότοιο: ἡδύποτος — sweet to drink, pleasant-tasting (of wine); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἣν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (fem. acc. sg.)
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἥ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. · also ὁ, ἡ, τό (personal/demonstrative pronoun): she; fem. nom. sg. (ἥ γε ’she indeed’, of the ship)
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’)
ἱππότα: ἱππότης — horseman, charioteer (epithet of Nestor); masc. nom. sg., old form in short -α
ἴδεν: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= εἶδεν)
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; + subj. · also + opt. after a past tense
ὀδυσσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (double-σ, metrical variant of single-σ Ὀδυσῆος)
ὀφθαλμοῖσι: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg.
ὁδὸν: ὁδός — way, journey; fem. acc. sg.
ὁμηλικίη: ὁμηλικίη — those of the same age, age-mates; fem. nom. sg., used predicatively of one person: ’he is my age-mate’
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἔτι κεῖνος ἀνὴρ ἐπιδήμιος ἦεν ’as long as that man was still at home’)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’until’, + indic. (ὄφρα ... βάλε): marking the point an action ceases · also temporal + subj. with κε, correlative with τόφρα: ’as long as, until’ (ὄφρα κε κείνη τοῦτον ἔχῃ νόον ’for as long as she holds this purpose’)
ὅδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. sg., elided (ὅδ’ = ὅδε)
ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron. (indefinite with τε/τις: ὅν τινα = ὅστις, ’whatever’); masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τινά
ὅπως: ὅπως — so that, in order that, how; + subj. or fut. indic. · also + opt., in secondary sequence after a past-tense verb, indirect deliberative: ’how it might’ (ὅπως ἄριστα γένοιτο ’how it might turn out best’)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when; temporal conjunction · also ’since, now that’ (ὅτε πρότερός γε πύθοιτο ’since he learned of it first’)
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; prep. + gen.; also + acc., ’under, up under’ · also of agent with a verb of dying, ‘by, at the hands of’ + gen. (ὤλεθ’ ὑπ’ Αἰγίσθοιο ‘perished by Aegisthus’)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; prep. + dat./acc.; also used as an adverb, ’beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis (ὑπὸ … ἐδήσατο = ὑπεδήσατο ’bound beneath’)
ὑψηλοῖο: ὑψηλός — high, lofty; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
ὕδωρ: ὕδωρ — water; neut. acc. sg. · also nom. sg. (identical neut. form), subject of a verb (ἄνεμός τε καὶ ὕδωρ ‘wind and current’)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
ὥς: ὥς — thus, so; also (with κε/ἄν + subj.) ’so that, in order that’; adverb/conjunction · also introducing an indirect question: ’how’ (ὥς κε νέηται ’how he is to return’, after φράσσεται) · or ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τε
ὧδε: ὧδε — here, to this place, in this way; adv.
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc. dat. sg.: ’his own (son)’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which; masc. dat. sg. (δοίη δ’ ᾧ κ’ ἐθέλοι ’give her to whom he wished’)
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
